research_status: 2014-2020 is disclosed iterative Development; 2021-2023 remains unopened until the Development gate passes
economic_hypothesis: A broad positive market and a rising PIT industry provide demand sponsorship. A stock's first limit-up through its prior 20-session high creates a new informed-holder cohort. If the next 2-8 completed sessions make a real pullback while closes preserve the ignition-body midpoint and turnover contracts sharply, available supply has fallen before a second markup attempt. Buying the first completed quiet-pullback state seeks that second wave without paying for a later relaunch breakout.
independence: This is not a collapse-gap repair strategy and does not use any V6/V7/V26 downward-gap identity.

binding_conditions.PIT_MARKET_INDUSTRY_BULL: market20 > 0, market breadth20 > 50%, PIT industry20 > 3%, PIT industry breadth20 > 55%, and signal-day PIT industry breadth > 45%
binding_conditions.FIRST_NONCROWDED_LIMITUP_IGNITION: ignition closes at its historical PIT up-limit, closes above the prior 20-session high, has zero limit-up closes in the prior 20 completed stock sessions, and pre-ignition 20-session return <= 15%
binding_conditions.FIRST_QUIET_PULLBACK: the first qualifying completed session 2-8 sessions after ignition; no intervening limit-up; post-ignition minimum close >= 98% of ignition body midpoint; post-ignition low <= 97% of ignition close; signal close is between ignition body midpoint and 102% of ignition close
binding_conditions.SUPPLY_CONTRACTION_AND_ACCEPTANCE: signal turnover <= 70% of ignition turnover; pre-signal interim mean turnover <= 80% of ignition turnover; signal return is between -2% and +4%; signal close location >= 55%

entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
